blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) can generate multiple tokens in parallel, but often require many decoding rounds to complete a response. Efficient generation depends not only on which tokens are easy to predict, but also on how committing to them helps predict the remaining positions. A highly predictable token may provide little useful context, while revealing a less predictable token can help several other positions become predictable sooner. We propose dSpark, a new schedule distillation-based framework for learning when to commit tokens for faster diffusion language generation. To achieve this, we construct unmasking schedules that prioritize tokens whose reveal makes other positions easier to predict, reducing uncertainty earlier in decoding. We then distill these schedules into the model to enable faster parallel sampling, with a KL-divergence regularizer to help preserve generation quality. We extensively evaluate our approach across mathematical reasoning and code generation tasks. On GSM8K, our method achieves remarkable 10.12$\times$ and 5.12$\times$ speedups over the various baselines on LLaDA-8B-Instruct and Dream-7B-Instruct, respectively, while maintaining superior task performance. Our code is available at https://github.com/VILA-Lab/dSpark.
blocks.zh: 分化出大型语言模型(dLLMs)可以并行生成多个符号,但往往需要许多解码回合来完成一个响应. 高效的生成不仅取决于哪些符号易于预测,还取决于如何对之作出承诺来帮助预测所剩位置。 一个非常可预测的标志可能无法提供有用的背景,而揭示一个不太可预测的标志可以帮助其他几个立场更早地变得可预测。 我们提出 dSpark, 一个新的基于分解时间表的框架, 学习何时为更快的传播语言生成承诺符号。 为了实现这一点,我们构建了揭开伪装的时间表,这些时间表将显示的标志列为优先事项,从而使其他位置更容易预测,从而减少早些时候在解码方面的不确定性。 然后我们把这些时间表分馏到模型中,以便能够更快地进行平行取样,使用KL-潜水常态器来帮助保存生成质量. 我们在数学推理和代码生成任务中广泛评价我们的方法。 在GSM8K上,我们的方法在LLaDA-8B-Instruct和Dream-7B-Instruct上分别实现显著的10.12美元和5.12美元的速度,同时保持了优异的任务性能. 我们的代码可查阅https://github.com/VILA-Lab/dSpark。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable capabilities across natural language understanding ( Brown et al., 2020 ; Ouyang et al., 2022 ; Achiam et al., 2023 ; Touvron et al., 2023 ; Grattafiori et al., 2024 ; Team et al., 2023 ) , and reasoning ( Kojima et al., 2022 ; Jaech et al., 2024 ; Guo et al., 2025 ) , yet efficient inference remains a fundamental challenge. Most LLMs adopt an autoregressive (AR) paradigm, producing each token conditioned on all previous tokens. This strict left-to-right dependency limits decoding parallelism: generating L L tokens typically requires L L sequential steps. Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) offer an appealing alternative by generating sequences through iterative denoising. From a partially or fully masked sequence, a dLLM predicts multiple masked positions in parallel and progressively commits them over a series of denoising rounds. Recent models such as LLaDA ( Nie et al., 2025 ) and Dream ( Ye et al., 2025 ) demonstrate that this paradigm can attain strong language modeling, reasoning, and coding capabilities while enabling flexible generation orders and much greater potential for parallel decoding ( Ben-Hamu et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2026b ; Chen et al., 2026a ) . However, realizing this potential requires reducing the many iterative model evaluations needed to turn a masked sequence into a complete response.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)在自然语言理解上取得了显著的能力(Brown等人,2020年;Ouyang等人,2022年;Achiam等人,2023年;Touvron等人,2023年;Grattafiori等人,2024年;Team等人,2023年)和推理(Kojima等人,2022年;Jaech等人,2024年;Guo等人,2025年),然而高效的推论仍然是一个根本性的挑战. 大多数LLMS采用自递式(AR)范式,每生产一个以所有之前的令牌为条件的令牌. 这种严格的左对右依赖限制解码平行主义:生成L符号一般需要L顺序步骤. 传播大型语言模型(dLLMs)通过迭代去诺化生成序列,提供了一个有吸引力的替代品. dLLM从部分或完全遮掩的序列中,预测多个遮掩的姿势平行,并逐渐将其投入一系列的除声弹中. 最近的一些模型,如LLaDA(Nie等人,2025年)和Dream(Ye等人,2025年)表明,这种范式能够实现强大的语言模型、推理和编码能力,同时能够灵活生成命令,并具有更大的平行解码潜力(Ben-Hamu等人,2025年;Wu等人,2026年b; 陈等,2026a). 然而,要发挥这种潜力,就需要减少许多迭代模式评价,以便把被掩盖的序列变为一个完整的反应。

blocks.en: A central factor governing dLLM inference efficiency is the unmasking schedule : which token positions should be committed at each decoding round and which should remain masked for subsequent refinement. Given the predictive distributions over all masked positions, a decoder may reveal one token, a fixed number of tokens, or a dynamically selected subset in each iteration. Committing more positions increases parallelism and reduces the number of decoding rounds, but overly aggressive commitments may introduce irreversible errors that contaminate the context used to predict other tokens. Conversely, conservative schedules preserve generation quality but sacrifice much of the computational advantage of parallel prediction. Existing decoding strategies therefore commonly rely on prediction confidence, e.g., committing positions whose maximum token probabilities are highest, under the intuition that highly confident predictions are safer to reveal. While effective as a simple heuristic, this strategy treats each masked position largely by its current local predictability and does not explicitly model how revealing it will change the difficulty of subsequent predictions.
blocks.zh: 指导dLLM推论效率的一个核心因素是解码时间表:每个解码回合应设置何种象征性位置,并应保持遮掩,供随后改进。 鉴于所有遮盖位置的预测分布,解码器可能揭示一个符号,一个固定的符号数,或者每个符号中动态选择的子集. 采取更多立场会增加平行性,减少编解码回合的数量,但过于激进的承诺可能会造成不可逆转的错误,污染用于预测其他标志的上下文。 相反,保守的时间表保持了生成质量,但牺牲了平行预测的计算优势。 因此,现有的解码战略通常依赖于预测信心,例如,在高度自信的预测能够更加安全地揭示的直觉下,承担最大象征性概率最高的位置。 这一策略虽然作为一个简单的heuristic方法很有效,但主要以其目前的局部可预测性来对待每个被掩盖的位置,并且没有明确模拟如何揭示它会改变以后预测的难度.

blocks.en: We argue that this distinction between predictability and utility is crucial for efficient diffusion language generation. The easiest token to predict is not necessarily the most useful token to commit. Consider two masked positions i i and j j . Position i i may already have an extremely peaked predictive distribution, yet revealing it may add almost no information about the rest of the sequence. In contrast, position j j may be moderately less certain but encode a critical semantic, syntactic, or reasoning decision, once j j is revealed, the uncertainty of several other positions may decrease substantially. This is particularly important in structured generation tasks such as mathematical reasoning and code synthesis, where intermediate decisions induce strong dependencies among downstream tokens. A schedule based solely on instantaneous confidence may therefore spend early commitments on safe but informationally redundant tokens, leaving influential positions unresolved for many more rounds. The effective decoding problem is thus not simply which tokens can be predicted now , but which tokens should be committed now so that the remaining sequence becomes easier to predict .

blocks.en: Motivated by this observation, we propose dSpark , a novel framework for learning when to commit tokens during diffusion language generation via schedule distillation . Our key idea is to construct informative unmasking schedules according to the downstream effect of each commitment rather than its confidence alone. We evaluate candidate commitments by how much revealing them helps reduce predictive uncertainty over the remaining positions. Tokens whose revelation makes multiple unresolved positions easier to determine are prioritized earlier, allowing useful context to propagate more rapidly. Decoding can thus be viewed as a context-construction process: every committed token not only resolves one position but also modifies the prediction problem of all remaining positions. By accounting for this effect, our schedules favor commitments with high future predictive value , producing trajectories that reduce sequence-level uncertainty faster than conventional confidence-driven schedules. This enables substantially more useful progress within each expensive model evaluation.
blocks.zh: 我们提出dSpark这个新框架, 我们的关键想法是,根据每项承诺的下游效果,而不是仅仅根据它的信心,制定内容翔实的、不露面的时间表。 我们评估候选承诺,说明它们在多大程度上有助于减少对其余职位的预测不确定性。 更早时会优先考虑其披露使多个未解决立场更容易确定的托肯,从而能够更快地传播有用的背景。 因此,解码可被视为一个环境构建过程:每一个承诺的象征不仅解决一个职位,而且改变所有剩余职位的预测问题。 由于考虑到这种影响,我们的时间表倾向于未来预测值较高的承诺,产生比传统信任驱动的时间表更快减少序列层次不确定性的轨迹。 这有助于在每次昂贵的模型评价中取得更有益的进展。

blocks.en: Constructing better schedules alone, however, can add computation if sophisticated token selection must be repeated during inference. We therefore further distill the behavior induced by these schedules into the model itself. The constructed schedules provide training trajectories that expose the model to commitment orders in which informative tokens are revealed early and the remaining predictions are progressively simplified. After distillation, the model can exploit these learned dependencies under efficient parallel sampling without expensive search over candidate schedules at every decoding step. Importantly, aggressively optimizing for fast commitment can alter the model’s original predictive behavior and degrade generation quality. To mitigate this, we introduce a KL-divergence regularizer that keeps the distilled model close to the original model distribution while learning to operate under accelerated schedules. Schedule distillation thus shifts computation from repeated inference-time schedule optimization into training, yielding a practical mechanism for jointly improving parallelism and preserving the generation capability of the underlying dLLM.
blocks.zh: 然而,如果在推论中必须重复复杂的符号选择,仅构建更好的时间表就可以增加计算。 因此,我们将这些时间表引起的行为进一步提炼成模型本身。 已建时间表提供了培训轨迹,使该模型面临承诺订单,其中提前披露信息信号,并逐步简化其余的预测。 蒸馏后,模型可以在高效的平行采样下利用这些学到的依赖性,而不在每个解码步骤对候选时间表进行昂贵的搜索. 重要的是,积极优化快速承诺可以改变模型最初的预测行为,降低生成质量。 为了缓解这种情况,我们引入了KL-潜水常态器,使蒸馏模型接近原模型分布,同时学会在加速调度下运行. 因此,时间表提炼将计算从反复推论时间优化转变为培训,从而形成一个实用机制,共同改进平行性,并保持基本 dLLM 的生成能力。

blocks.en: We extensively evaluate dSpark on two representative models, LLaDA-8B-Instruct and Dream-7B-Instruct, across mathematical reasoning and code generation benchmarks. The results demonstrate that learning when to commit is a powerful yet underexplored dimension for accelerating dLLMs. On GSM8K, our approach achieves 10.12 × \times and 5.12 × \times speedups over the baselines for LLaDA and Dream, respectively, while maintaining superior task performance. This shows that generation efficiency depends not merely on how many tokens are predicted in parallel, but on how effectively each commitment restructures the prediction problem for later rounds. Our main contributions are:

blocks.en: • We identify a key limitation of existing diffusion language model decoding strategies: token confidence alone does not capture the downstream utility of a commitment. We show that revealing a less predictable but more informative token can reduce uncertainty over multiple remaining positions and lead to faster overall decoding. • We propose schedule distillation , a new strategy that constructs unmasking schedules by prioritizing tokens according to how much their commitment simplifies future predictions. We further distill these informative schedules into the model, enabling efficient parallel decoding without requiring expensive schedule optimization at inference time. • We extensively validate our method across mathematical reasoning and code generation tasks on multiple dLLMs. On GSM8K, it achieves up to 10.12 × \times speedup on LLaDA-8B-Instruct and 5.12 × \times on Dream-7B-Instruct while maintaining strong generation quality.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Diffusion Language Models. Discrete diffusion models generate sequences by reversing a corruption process, and subsequent work developed stronger objectives for language modeling, including SEDD, MDLM, and RADD ( Austin et al., 2021a ; Lou et al., 2024 ; Sahoo et al., 2024 ; Ou et al., 2025 ) . LLaDA ( Nie et al., 2025 ) scaled masked diffusion to an instruction-following language model trained from scratch, while Dream ( Ye et al., 2025 ) demonstrated strong reasoning and coding performance with a model initialized from an autoregressive LLM. Other work combines diffusion within blocks with generation across blocks or scales diffusion models further through conversion from autoregressive models ( Arriola et al., 2025 ; Bie et al., 2025 ; Zhu et al., 2026 ) . These advances establish capable diffusion backbones, but their iterative generation process leaves substantial room to improve inference efficiency.
blocks.zh: 传播语言模型. 分散传播模式通过扭转腐败过程产生序列,随后的工作为语言建模制定了更强有力的目标,包括SEDD、MDLM和RADD(Austin等人,2021a); Lou等人,2024年;Sahoo等人,2024年;Ou等人,2025年). LLADA(Nie等人,2025年)将遮掩传播缩放为从零开始训练的跟随教学的语言模型,而Dream(Ye等人,2025年)则用自旋LLM初始化的模型表现出强烈的推理和编码性能. 其他工作将区块内的传播与跨区块的生成或尺度传播模型进一步结合起来,通过自递性模型的转换(Arriola等人,2025年;Bie等人,2025年;Zhu等人,2026年)。 这些进步建立了有能力的传播骨干,但其迭代生成过程为提高推论效率留下了很大的空间.

blocks.en: Efficient Diffusion Language Decoding. Existing methods reduce either the cost or the number of decoding steps. Fast-dLLM ( Wu et al., 2026b ) , dKV-Cache ( Ma et al., 2025a ) , Elastic-Cache ( Nguyen-Tri et al., 2026 ) , and dInfer ( Ma et al., 2025b ) improve cache reuse and inference execution, while D2F ( Wang et al., 2026 ) and Fast-dLLM v2 ( Wu et al., 2026a ) use block-based generation to support efficient parallel decoding. Other approaches distill generation into fewer steps or enable more aggressive token updates ( Deschenaux and Gulcehre, 2025 ; Sahoo et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2026a ) . Closest to our work, dParallel ( Chen et al., 2026b ) uses certainty-forcing distillation to make tokens ready earlier, whereas d3LLM ( Qian et al., 2026 ) distills pseudo-trajectories and applies multi-block decoding. Training-free approaches such as LEAP ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) and Ripple-Pivot Search ( Ye et al., 2026 ) use lookahead to identify tokens worth committing early.
blocks.zh: 高效传播语言解码. 现有方法减少了成本或解码步骤的数量. 快速dLLLM 软件 (Wu等人,2026b),dKV-Cache(Ma等人,2025a),Elastic-Cache(Nguyen-Tri等人,2026年),和dInfer(Ma等人,2025b)改进缓存再利用和推论执行,而D2F(Wang等人,2026年)和Fast-dLLM v2(Wu等人,2026a)则使用块基生成支持高效的平行解码. 其他方法将生成物蒸馏成较少的步骤,或能够进行更积极的符号更新(Deschenaux and Gulcehre,2025;Sahoo等人,2025;Chen等人,2026a)。 与我们的工作最接近的是,dParallel(Chen等人,2026年b)采用确定性强化蒸馏法来制备先期的代币,而d3LLM(Qian等人,2026年b)蒸馏伪导器并应用多块解码. LEAP(Zhang等人,2026年)和Ripple-Pivot搜索(Ye等人,2026年)等无培训方法,使用望头来识别值得提前承诺的标志.

blocks.en: 4.1 Motivation

blocks.en: The order in which tokens are revealed can affect how quickly a dLLM completes a response. Each reveal provides context for the remaining positions, but some tokens help more than others. We measure this with the frozen base model p θ 0 p_{\theta_{0}} on a correct response y y . In a partially decoded state s s , the model’s uncertainty about the target token at a masked position j j is its surprisal h j ​ ( s ) = − log ⁡ p θ 0 ​ ( y j ∣ s , j ) h_{j}(s)=-\log p_{\theta_{0}}(y_{j}\mid s,j) . Fig. 1(a) and 1(b) show that revealing less predictable target tokens (larger h i h_{i} ) can reduce uncertainty at other positions and help more predictions match the correct response. We call a position ready when the model’s most likely token matches the ground truth. Revealing an uncertain token makes 5.1 × 5.1\times more other positions ready than revealing a confident one (Fig. 1(b) ) and lowers their surprisal 4.7 × 4.7\times more (Fig. 1(a) ). A useful schedule should therefore consider how each token helps predict the remaining positions, as well as how confident the model is about that token.

blocks.en: What matters for efficient decoding is not only how much uncertainty a reveal removes, but how early it removes it. Following the masked-token surprisal sum inside the brackets of Eq. ( 2 ), we measure remaining reference uncertainty and its accumulated area as H ⁡ ( s r , y ) = ∑ j ∈ ℳ r h j ​ ( s r ) , 𝒜 ⁡ ( π , y ) = ∑ r = 0 T − 1 H ⁡ ( s r , y ) . H(s_{r};y)=\sum_{j\in\mathcal{M}_{r}}h_{j}(s_{r}),\qquad\mathcal{A}(\pi;y)=\sum_{r=0}^{T-1}H(s_{r};y). (4) The area adds up the model’s remaining uncertainty at every decoding round. If revealing a token early makes other tokens easier to predict, their uncertainty is lower in the following rounds and the total area is smaller. Two schedules can therefore produce the same response but have different areas. Figure 2(a) illustrates this: under the natural schedule, the remaining uncertainty stays high for many rounds before it falls, whereas promoting tokens that help the other positions makes it drop earlier and shifts the whole curve to the left, removing the hatched area from 𝒜 \mathcal{A} . Since the response is fixed, this gain comes only from the order of reveals. A smaller area also means faster completion. Responses with larger areas under the natural schedule tend to require more forward passes (Fig. 1(c) ), and optimized schedules finish verified responses in fewer rounds, never take longer, and gain the most on the responses that need the most rounds (Fig. 2(b) ). Our method starts from the natural schedule and searches for tokens whose earlier reveal helps other positions become ready sooner.

blocks.en: We train the student on intermediate states s r ∗ s_{r}^{*} from the optimized trajectory τ ∗ ​ ( y ) \tau^{*}(y) . The correct response provides the token targets, while the schedule determines which tokens are visible in each training example. The student, therefore, learns to predict the remaining tokens from contexts in which informative positions have been revealed earlier.

Let 𝒟 + \mathcal{D}_{+} denote the distribution of correct responses y y and states s r ∗ s_{r}^{*} sampled from τ ∗ ​ ( y ) \tau^{*}(y) . blocks.en: 5.1 Experimental Setup

blocks.en: Training Data. We build a separate distillation corpus for each backbone. For both models, we generate the trajectories from GSM8K ( Cobbe et al., 2021 ) , PRM12K ( Lightman et al., 2024 ) , NuminaMath-CoT ( LI et al., 2024 ) , and AceCode ( Zeng et al., 2025 ) using a maximum length of 256 256 tokens, with a block size of 32 32 . Overall, the training data contains 52k correct and 38k incorrect samples for LLaDA, and 80k correct and 57k incorrect for Dream. During training, we use all correct trajectories and subsample the incorrect ones to a 4 : 1 4{:}1 ratio, yielding 52k correct and 13k incorrect trajectories for LLaDA, and 80k correct and 20k incorrect for Dream.
blocks.zh: 培训数据。 我们为每个骨干建造一个单独的蒸馏器 对于这两个模型,我们生成了GSM8K(Cobbe等人,2021年),PRM12K(Lightman等人,2024年),NuminaMath-CoT的轨迹. (LI等人,2024年),和AceCode(Zeng等人,2025年)使用最高长度为256,256令牌,块大小为32,32. 总体而言,培训数据包含LLaDA的52k正确和38k不正确的样本,Dream的80k正确和57k不正确. 在训练期间,我们使用所有正确的轨迹,并将不正确的轨迹做为4:1 4{:}1 比例,为LLaDA得出52k正确和13k不正确的轨迹,为Dream得出80k正确和20k不正确.

blocks.en: Implementation Details. In our experiments we use LLaDA-Instruct ( Nie et al., 2025 ) and Dream-Instruct ( Ye et al., 2025 ) models. We fine-tune the models using LoRA ( Hu et al., 2021 ) . We use a multi-block decoding strategy similar to d3LLM ( Qian et al., 2026 ) . To create a set of target tokens in Eq. 5 , we use p m ​ i ​ n = 0.02 p_{min}=0.02 and k = 10 k=10 . We set β = 1 \beta=1 in the training objective in Eq. 9 . Training configurations and hardware details are provided in the Appendix.

blocks.en: Evaluation Details. Our evaluation covers mathematical reasoning on GSM8K (0-shot) ( Cobbe et al., 2021 ) and MATH (4-shot) ( Hendrycks et al., 2021 ) , and code generation on HumanEval (0-shot) ( Chen et al., 2021 ) and MBPP (3-shot) ( Austin et al., 2021b ) . We report accuracy for math and pass@ 1 1 for code, together with tokens per forward (TPF) and accuracy under parallelism (AUP) ( Qian et al., 2026 ) . The results are averaged over three independent evaluation runs. We use lm-eval-harness ( Gao et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 评价细节。 我们的评价涵盖了GSM8K(0-shot)(Cobbe等人,2021年)和MATH(4-shot)的数学推理(Hendrycks等人,2021年),以及HumanEval(0-shot)的代码生成(Chen等人,2021年)和MBPP(3-shot)(Austin等人,2021年b). 我们报告数学和密码的准确度@ 1 1, 加上每个前方的符号(TPF)和平行主义(AUP)下的准确度(Qian等人, 2026年)。 平均结果为三次独立评价。 我们使用lm-eval-harness(Gao等人,2024年).

blocks.en: Baselines. We evaluate our method against competitive dLLM baselines. These include the vanilla LLaDA ( Nie et al., 2025 ) and Dream ( Ye et al., 2025 ) models and the training-free Fast-dLLM ( Wu et al., 2026b ) . We also compare with methods that fine-tune the model for faster decoding, namely dParallel ( Chen et al., 2026b ) , d3LLM ( Qian et al., 2026 ) , and D2F ( Wang et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 基线。 我们根据具有竞争力的 dLLM 基线来评估我们的方法。 其中包括vanilla LLaDA(Nie等人,2025年)和Dream(Ye等人,2025年)模型以及无培训的Fast-dLLM(Wu等人,2026年b). 我们还比较了微调更快速解码模型的方法,即dParallel(Chen等人,2026年b),d3LLM(Qian等人,2026年),和D2F(Wang等人,2026年).

blocks.en: 5.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 5.2 主要成果

blocks.en: Table 1: Results by benchmark and backbone. Accuracy, tokens per forward (TPF), and accuracy under parallelism (AUP) for LLaDA-8B-Instruct and Dream-7B-Instruct.
blocks.zh: 表1:按基准和支柱分列的结果。 准确度,每个前方的符号(TPF),以及LLaDA-8B-指令和Dream-7B-指令在并行主义(AUP)下的精确度.

blocks.en: Table 1 shows that dSpark achieves the highest TPF and AUP across all four benchmarks on both backbones. The results demonstrate a consistent improvement in the accuracy–parallelism trade-off, with the relative contributions of accuracy retention and increased parallelism varying across tasks.
blocks.zh: 表1显示dSpark在两个主干的所有四个基准中实现了最高的TPF和AUP. 结果表明,准确性----并行性权衡不断改进,准确性保留和日益增强的并行性的相对贡献因任务而异。

blocks.en: Results on LLaDA. On GSM8K, dSpark achieves 10.12 × 10.12\times the decoding parallelism of the base model while maintaining the base model’s accuracy. Compared to d3LLM, it further increases parallelism while closing the accuracy gap relative to the base model, resulting in a 33.3 % 33.3\% improvement in AUP. On MATH, dSpark similarly preserves base-model performance while achieving the highest TPF and AUP. The code benchmarks show that the benefits extend beyond mathematical reasoning. On HumanEval, dSpark matches d3LLM’s pass@1 while decoding more tokens per forward pass. On MBPP, it improves both pass@1 and TPF over d3LLM. Across all four tasks, dSpark makes better use of parallel decoding than the competing methods, with the highest AUP in every case.
blocks.zh: 关于LLaDA的结果。 在GSM8K上,dSpark实现10.12×10.12\的比基模型的解码平行性,同时保持比基模型的准确性. 与d3LLM相比,它进一步增加了并行性,同时缩小了与基模型相比的精度差距,使得AUP的改进率达到33.3% 33.3\%. 在MATH上,dSpark同样保留了基模性能,同时实现了最高的TPF和AUP. 代码基准显示,这些好处超越了数学推理. 在 HumanEval 上, dSpark 匹配 d3LLM 的传球@ 1, 同时每向前传解码更多的信使 。 在MBPP上,它比d3LLM同时改进了通过@1和TPF. 在所有四项任务中,dSpark比竞争方法更好地使用平行解码,每个案例的AUP最高.

blocks.en: Results on Dream. On GSM8K, dSpark achieves 5.12 × 5.12\times the base model’s TPF while improving accuracy by 1.5 % 1.5\% . Relative to d3LLM, the larger parallelism gains occur on code generation: TPF increases by 30.4 % 30.4\% on MBPP and 36.4 % 36.4\% on HumanEval, accompanied by higher pass@1 on both benchmarks. These improvements give dSpark a substantial AUP lead on the two code tasks and show that its advantage extends across backbones. On MATH, the gain over d3LLM is smaller, but dSpark still achieves the highest TPF and AUP. On MBPP, dSpark achieves the highest TPF and AUP of all compared methods, while also improving pass@1 over d3LLM.
blocks.zh: 梦上的结果。 在GSM8K上,dSpark实现5.12×5.12\的基模型的TPF,同时将精度提高1.5%1.5%. 相对于d3LLM,更大的平行增益发生在代码生成上:TPF在MBPP上增加30.4% 30.4\%,在HumanEval上增加36.4% 36.4\%,同时在两个基准上增加高传@1. 这些改进使得dSpark在两个代码任务上有一个实质性的AUP领先,并表明其优势扩展到了骨干. 在MATH上,对d3LLM的增益较小,但dSpark仍然实现了最高的TPF和AUP. 在MBPP上,dSpark实现了所有比较方法中最高的TPF和AUP,同时也在d3LLM上改进了pass@1.

blocks.en: Accuracy–parallelism trade-off. Figure 4 shows why dSpark leads in AUP. Methods can decode more tokens per forward pass by accepting a sharp drop in accuracy. dSpark achieves higher TPF while maintaining strong accuracy. This is clearest on GSM8K, where it achieves both the highest TPF and the highest accuracy on LLaDA and Dream. On HumanEval, it exceeds d3LLM’s TPF without losing pass@1 on LLaDA and improves both measures on Dream. The other plots show the same overall pattern: dSpark moves decoding toward greater parallelism while preserving enough task performance to make that gain useful. These results are consistent with the goal of dSpark, which encourages the model to reveal informative tokens earlier so that more of the remaining positions can be predicted together. The KL regularizer helps dSpark retain accuracy under aggressive parallel decoding, giving it an advantage over competing methods at higher TPF.
blocks.zh: 准确性 - 平行主义权衡. 图4显示了dSpark为何在AUP中领先. 方法可以通过接受精确度的急剧下降来解码每个前方的更多符号. dSpark在保持强烈准确性的同时,实现了更高的TPF. 这在GSM8K上最为清晰,在LLaDA和Dream上既实现了最高的TPF,也实现了最高的准确度. 在HumanEval上, 它超过d3LLM的TPF, 其他图则显示了相同的总体模式: dSpark 向更大的并行性移动解码,同时保留足够的任务性能,使这种收益有用. 这些结果与dSpark的目标是一致的,它鼓励该模型更早地披露信息化的征兆,以便可以一起预测更多的剩余位置. KL常态器帮助dSpark在主动性的平行解码下保持精度,使其在较高的TPF中比竞争方法有优势.

blocks.en: Confidence and False Positives. Distillation for parallel decoding makes a model confident enough to commit many tokens per forward pass. The risk is that it also becomes confident about wrong tokens, which a threshold decoder then commits. Table 8 measures this on the natural schedules of 250 test GSM8K samples, recording at every round the prediction at every masked position. The three distilled models are confident about a similar share of correct predictions. Among wrong predictions, however, d3LLM and dParallel are confident for 22.9 % 22.9\% and 21.7 % 21.7\% , while dSpark is confident for 15.5 % 15.5\% , so its confident predictions are correct 91 % 91\% of the time, against 82 % 82\% for the two baselines. Figure 5 breaks these predictions into confidence bins. The base model is well calibrated: in every bin, its accuracy is close to its confidence. dParallel and d3LLM are overconfident at every confidence level; for example, their predictions made with a confidence between 0.8 0.8 and 0.9 0.9 are correct only 51 % 51\% and 52 % 52\% of the time. dSpark stays much closer to the diagonal, at 65 % 65\% in the same bin, although it places slightly more predictions in the top bin than the two baselines. Its expected calibration error is also substantially lower than theirs. This more reliable confidence helps explain why dSpark can commit tokens aggressively without the same loss of accuracy.
blocks.zh: 信心与假阳性. 平行解码的沉淀使模型具有足够的信心,每向前行驶时就投下许多令牌. 风险在于,它也会对错误的征兆产生信心,然后是阈值解码器造成的。 表8按250个测试GSM8K样本的自然时间表衡量,每轮记录每个遮掩位置的预测。 三种蒸馏模型对同样比例的正确预测充满信心. 然而,在错误的预测中,d3LLM和dParallel对22.9% 22.9\%和21.7% 21.7\%有信心,而dSpark对15.5% 15.5\%的信心,因此其自信的预测是91%91\%正确的时间,而两个基线为82% 82\%. 图5将这些预测破解为置信箱. 基础模型的校准性很好:在每一个弹箱中,它的精确度都接近其信心. dParallel和d3LLM在每个置信级别上都是过度自信的;例如,他们在0.8 0.8至0.9 0.9之间以置信度作出的预测只有51%的51%的52%的52%的52%的52%的时段是正确的. dSpark与对角线保持远近,在65%65%的同位素中,虽然它比两个基线在上方的垃圾桶中放置了略多的预测. 它的预期校准误差也大大低于它们. 这种更可靠的信心有助于解释为什么dSpark可以在不丧失同样准确性的情况下,肆无忌惮地作出表示。

blocks.en: 5.3 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 5.3 读取研究

blocks.en: Ablation Study on Training Recipe. To examine the contribution of each component, we ablate schedule distillation and KL regularization on LLaDA, with results shown in Table 2 . Using ordinary trajectory training without optimized schedule and KL, it achieves the accuracy of 74.9 and TPF of 7.6 on GSM8K, and 37.9 accuracy and 5.2 TPF on Humaneval. Using the schedule alone substantially increases TPF on both GSM8K and HumanEval, but accuracy declines as the model commits more tokens in parallel. KL regularization alone has the opposite effect: it improves accuracy but reduces TPF, leading to lower AUP than the variant without either component. Combining the two gives the best balance. The full recipe retains 10.1 TPF on GSM8K and 6.7 TPF on HumanEval while raising accuracy to 78.9% and 39.6%, respectively. It achieves the highest AUP on both tasks. These results show that the schedule is responsible for the parallelism gain, while KL regularization helps prevent that gain from coming at the expense of accuracy.
blocks.zh: 训导学研究. 为了审查每个部分的贡献,我们将时间表提炼和KL正规化纳入LLADA,结果见表2。 它使用普通的轨迹训练而不优化时间表和KL,在GSM8K上达到74.9和TPF的精度7.6,在Humaneval上达到37.9的精度和5.2的TPF. 单使用时间表就大大增加了GSM8K和HumanEval的TPF,但随着模型同时做出更多符号,准确性下降. 单KL规范化具有相反的效果:它提高了精度但降低了TPF,导致AUP低于没有两个元件的变体. 将两者结合起来,就是最好的平衡。 全食谱保留了GSM8K上的10.1TPF和HumanEval上的6.7TPF,同时将精度分别提高到78.9%和39.6%. 它在两项任务上都实现了最高的AUP. 这些结果表明,时间表对平行收益负责,而KL正规化有助于防止这种收益以准确性为代价。

blocks.en: Table 3: Accuracy and TPF on LLaDA GSM8K with different ratios of correct to incorrect training trajectories.

blocks.en: To validate our choice of training mixture, we ablate the ratio of correct to incorrect trajectories on LLaDA and evaluate the resulting models on GSM8K, as shown in Table 3 . Without incorrect trajectories, the model reaches 11.4 TPF but only 74.19% accuracy. Adding incorrect samples improves accuracy, although a larger share generally reduces parallelism. We choose a 4 : 1 4{:}1 ratio because it retains 10.12 TPF while raising accuracy to 78.94%. Increasing the share further to 1 : 1 1{:}1 brings only a small gain in accuracy, while TPF falls to 7.90. At 2 : 1 2{:}1 , both accuracy and TPF are lower than at 4 : 1 4{:}1 , reaching 78.04% and 9.77, respectively. We also test using a separate, disjoint set of correct trajectories for KL regularization, keeping the same ratio of 4 : 1 4{:}1 . Compared with using incorrect trajectories at the same ratio, accuracy falls from 78.94% to 77.10%, and TPF drops by 30.5%. Together, these results support using incorrect trajectories for KL regularization at a 4 : 1 4{:}1 ratio, which provides a strong balance between accuracy and parallel decoding.
blocks.zh: 为了验证我们所选择的训练混合物,我们降低了LLaDA上正确与不正确轨迹的比例,并如表3所示,评价了GSM8K上产生的模型。 没有不正确的轨迹,模型达到了11.4TPF,但只有74.19%的精度. 添加不正确的样本会提高准确性,尽管更大的份额一般会降低平行性. 我们选择一个 4: 1 4{} 1 比率,因为它保留了10.12 TPF,同时将精确度提高到78.94%. 将份额进一步提升到1:1{{}1只带来微小的准确性收益,而TPF则降至7.90. 2:1 2{:}1,准确度和TPF均低于4:1 4{:}1,分别达到78.04%和9.77. 我们还使用一套单独的,脱节的正确轨迹进行测试,用于KL正规化,保持4:1 4{}1的相同比例. 与使用同样比例的错误轨迹相比,精度从78.94%下降到77.10%,TPF下降了30.5%。 这些结果支持一起使用不正确的轨迹进行KL正规化,比例为4:1 4{:}1,这为准确度和平行解码提供了有力的平衡.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we studied efficient decoding for diffusion large language models from the perspective of when to commit predicted tokens. We showed that token confidence alone is insufficient for effective scheduling, since some less predictable tokens can provide more useful context for resolving the remaining sequence. We introduce dSpark enabled by schedule distillation , which constructs informative unmasking schedules based on the downstream utility of token commitments and distills these schedules into the model for efficient parallel inference. Experiments on mathematical reasoning and code generation show substantial acceleration, including 10.12 × \times and 5.12 × 5.12\times speedups on GSM8K for LLaDA-8B-Instruct and Dream-7B-Instruct, respectively, while maintaining strong task performance. Our results highlight unmasking schedules as an important learnable component of diffusion language modeling and suggest that better commitment strategies can substantially narrow the gap between the theoretical parallelism and practical efficiency of dLLMs.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们研究了从何时承诺预言符号的角度传播大型语言模型的有效解码. 我们表明,仅仅象征性的信任不足以有效地安排时间,因为一些不太可预测的迹象可以为解决剩余的顺序提供更有用的背景。 我们通过时间表蒸馏引入dSpark,它根据象征性承诺的下游效用构建了信息解密时间表,并将这些时间表提炼成高效平行推论的模式。 关于数学推理和代码生成的实验显示大幅加速,包括10.12 ×\times和5.12 × 5.12\times在GSM8K上分别用于LLaDA-8B-Instruct和Dream-7B-Instruct,同时保持强任务性能. 我们的成果突出表明,不装模作样的时间表是传播语言模型的一个重要可学习的组成部分,并表明,更好的承诺战略可以大大缩小dLLM的理论平行性和实际效率之间的差距。

blocks.en: Ethics Statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en: This work focuses on improving the inference efficiency of diffusion large language models and does not involve human subjects or the collection of sensitive personal data. Our method does not introduce new model capabilities beyond those of the underlying pretrained models and therefore inherits their existing limitations and potential risks, including biased, harmful, or inaccurate generations. By reducing the number of decoding steps required during inference, the proposed approach can also help lower computational cost and energy consumption.
blocks.zh: 这项工作的重点是提高传播大型语言模型的推论效率,不涉及人类主体或收集敏感的个人数据. 我们的方法没有在经过预先培训的基本模型之外引入新的模型能力,因此继承了它们现有的局限性和潜在风险,包括有偏见、有害或不准确的几代人。 通过减少推论期间所需的解码步骤数量,提议的方法也有助于降低计算成本和能量消耗.

blocks.en: Reproducibility Statement
blocks.zh: 可复制声明

blocks.en: A.1 Wall-Clock Throughput and KV Caching

blocks.en: TPF counts forward passes, but a forward pass with a longer context costs more time. We measure wall-clock throughput on NVIDIA A100-SXM4 GPUs with batch size 1. Table 4 therefore reports the wall-clock throughput of dSpark on LLaDA, without a KV cache and with the prefix and dual caches of Fast-dLLM ( Wu et al., 2026b ) . dSpark runs with both caches. With the short 0-shot prompt, the caches barely change throughput (253 and 213 tokens/s, against 249 without a cache), since they also increase the number of forward passes (from 24.8 to 29.4 with the prefix cache). With a 5-shot prompt, the prefix cache raises throughput from 92 to 155 tokens/s ( 1.7 × 1.7\times ) at similar accuracy. At 512 tokens, the caches lower accuracy by 1.1–2.7 points without raising throughput. Caching is therefore most useful for long prompts, and dSpark reaches 249 tokens/s without it.
blocks.zh: TPF计算前传,但前传上下文较长则花费更多的时间. 我们用批量大小的NVIDIA A100-SXM4 GPU测量墙钟吞吐量 1. 因此,表4在LLaDA上报告dSpark的时钟吞吐量,没有KV缓存,并有Fast-dLLM的前缀和双重缓存(Wu等人,2026年b)。 dSpark同时运行两个缓存. 随着短的0射速率,缓存几乎不会改变吞吐量(253和213个令牌/秒,而不是没有缓存的249个),因为它们也增加了前传通行证(前缀缓存从24.8个增加到29.4个). 使用5发的提示,前缀缓存以相似的精确度将吞吐量从92升至155个令牌/秒(1.7×1.7\时). 在512令牌上,缓存的精度在不提高吞吐量的情况下降低了1.1–2.7分. 因此,缓存对长的提示最有用,而dSpark没有它就达到了249个令牌/秒.

blocks.en: We also implement a static KV cache that runs every decoding step as a captured CUDA graph. It keeps the keys and values of the prompt and of committed tokens and, at each step, recomputes only the active window, the block behind it and a rotating slice of 64 cached positions, so that every cached position is refreshed periodically. With this cache, dSpark generates 313 tokens/s at 79.2 % 79.2\% accuracy with the 0-shot prompt, 260 tokens/s with the 5-shot prompt and 300 tokens/s at 512 tokens, 1.3 1.3 – 2.8 × 2.8\times its throughput without a cache, with accuracy within 1.3 points of it (Table 4 ).

blocks.en: Effect of Generation Length. Table 6 compares performance at maximum generation lengths of 128, 256, and 512 tokens. dSpark achieves the highest TPF in every setting and the highest accuracy in five of six settings. blocks.en: D.1 Candidate Filter
blocks.zh: D.1 候选人过滤器

blocks.en: A promoted token is committed before the frozen model would commit it on its own, so it is, by construction, a token the model is not yet confident about. The filter in Eq. ( 5 ) therefore does not ask for confidence. It only asks that the reference token be plausible to the model: among its k = 10 k=10 most likely tokens at that position, with a probability of at least p min = 0.02 p_{\min}=0.02 , i.e., a surprisal of at most about 4 nats, the range shown in Figure 1 . The two bounds complement each other. When the model’s distribution is flat, many tokens exceed 2 % 2\% and the rank bound applies; when it is peaked, the tenth-ranked token can have a negligible probability and the probability bound applies.
blocks.zh: 在被冻结的模型自行承诺之前,一个促进的标志是承诺的,因此,通过建造,这个模型还没有信心的标志. 因此,Eq.(5)中的过滤器不要求信任。 它只要求该参考符对模型来说是可信的:在它的k = 10 k = 10 最可能在该位置上的标志符中,至少有p min = 0.02 p_{\min}=0.02 的概率,即最多为4纳特的追加符,范围如图1所示. 两界相补. 当模型的分布平坦时,许多符符超过2%的2\%,等级约束适用;当它达到峰值时,排名第十的符符可以有可忽略的概率,而概率约束适用.

blocks.en: Why not a stricter filter. The tokens that help the other positions most are rarely the confident ones. As shown in Figure 1 , revealing an uncertain token ( p θ 0 < 0.5 p_{\theta_{0}}<0.5 ) makes 5.1 × 5.1\times more other positions ready than revealing a confident one and lowers their surprisal 4.7 × 4.7\times more. A filter that asks for confidence would therefore exclude the most useful promotions. Promoting these low-probability tokens also does not cost accuracy (Table 10 ).
blocks.zh: 为什么不更严格的过滤器。 帮助其他职位的标志很少是自信的。 如图1所示,披露一个不确定的标志(p θ0 < 0.5 p_{\theta_{0}}<0.5)使得5.1×5.1×时,其他位置的准备量比披露一个自信的要多,而降低其附加品4.7×4.7×时。 因此,要求信任的过滤器将排除最有用的晋升。 推广这些低概率符号也不符合准确性(表10)。

blocks.en: Why not a looser filter. Below these bounds, the model has effectively ruled the reference token out given the current context. Promoting such a token would make the schedule depend on knowing the verified answer rather than on the model’s own uncertainty, and would train the student to commit a token that its context does not support. The bounds also keep the search small, since every candidate is scored with its own forward pass in Eq. ( 6 ). We set p min p_{\min} and k k from these considerations and did not tune them in end-to-end training.
blocks.zh: 为什么不用更松的过滤器呢? 在这些界限之下,模型有效地排除了参照符,考虑到当前的上下文. 推广这样的标志,将使时间表取决于是否知道经过核实的答案,而不是模型本身的不确定性,并训练学生做出一个其背景不支持的标志。 极限也保持了搜索小幅,因为每个候选人都有自己在Eq. (6 )的前进通行证。 我们从这些考虑中设定了 p min p_{\min 和 k k , 并没有在端到端的训练中调整它们.

blocks.en: To test whether low-probability promotions cost accuracy, we take 240 states at which the schedule promotes a token, 80 per probability range, and finish decoding either by committing the promoted token or by committing nothing. Table 10 shows that committing the promoted token leaves accuracy unchanged within sampling noise while reducing the forward passes needed to finish, by 6.5 6.5 for the least likely tokens.

blocks.en: D.2 Token Promotion Strategy.
blocks.zh: D.2 托肯促进战略。

blocks.en: We compare the proposed surprisal-reduction criterion Eq. ( 6 ) with the natural schedule, random promotion of a plausible token, and promotion of the highest-surprisal token on GSM8K as shown in Table 11 . Without KL regularization, our criterion reaches 11.4 TPF, compared with 7.6 for the natural schedule and 8.3 for random promotion. Promoting the highest-surprisal token reaches 10.1 TPF but lowers accuracy to 73.3%. With KL regularization, our criterion achieves the highest TPF and accuracy, at 10.1 and 78.9%, respectively. It improves both measures over highest-surprisal promotion (8.9 TPF and 77.8% accuracy) and raises TPF substantially over random promotion (7.5) while maintaining similar accuracy. These results support selecting tokens for how much they simplify the remaining predictions, rather than for their own surprisal alone.
